summary: Unexpected private connector egress fee applied to enterprise invoice
description:
Issue summary:
Customer (Acme Analytics, enterprise/private deployment) reports an unexpected line item on the monthly invoice labeled 'Private Connector Egress - eu-west' that they do not recognize and which they say is not in their contract. Customer believes egress connectors are bundled in their enterprise agreement.

Impact:
- One-off charge 317.42 EUR on invoice INV-2026-03-ACME-01.
- Customer concerned about recurring application of this fee and wants immediate reversal and explanation.

Environment:
- Private deployment in eu-west using on-prem connector v1.9.3 with control plane in Redwood-hosted account.
- Contract reference: EA-ACME-2025 (enterprise tier, connector egress included).

Initial invoice excerpt provided by customer (redacted):
- Line 1: Model Inference - chat_turbo_v2 - 1,204.12 EUR
- Line 2: Private Connector Egress - eu-west - 317.42 EUR
- Line 3: Reserved Capacity - Dedicated (monthly) - -200.00 EUR

Customer request:
- Explain why 'Private Connector Egress' was billed despite enterprise contract wording.
- Confirm whether this was a metering error and reverse if incorrect.
- Provide mitigation steps to prevent recurrence.
steps_to_reproduce: Customer provided invoice and connector ID: conn-eu-9a2f. Reproduce by querying billing events for customer_acct_id=acct-ACME-77 for date range 2026-02-28 to 2026-03-01.
Run billing event search in billing-service: SELECT * FROM events WHERE connector_id='conn-eu-9a2f' AND event_type='egress_meter' AND period='2026-02-01'
Cross-check tag mapping table in billing-router for tenant tags applied during postback processing for private deployments.
logs_and_invoice_lines:
Invoice INV-2026-03-ACME-01 (issued 2026-03-02):
  - Description: Private Connector Egress - eu-west
  - Quantity: 1
  - Unit price: 317.42 EUR
  - Rate tag: connector-egress-v2 | tariff: eu-west-egress | applied_rate_id: rt-2333

Billing event sample (billing-events-prod):
  timestamp=2026-03-01T02:15:12Z, event_id=ev-9b4, tenant=acct-ACME-77, connector_id=conn-eu-9a2f, meter_type=egress, tokens=0, cost=317.42, rate_id=rt-2333

Connector metadata (connectors-prod):
  conn-eu-9a2f -> deployment_type=private, owner=acct-ACME-77, installed_at=2025-09-10
investigation: Checked contract: EA-ACME-2025 includes 'connector egress: included for enterprise customers for first 10TB / month'; usage under threshold for February (0.8TB).

Queried billing-router logs for postback normalization: found a recent deploy (2026-02-25) that introduced new rate tagging logic (PR 4823) which maps connector feature_flag 'egress-metering-v2' to rate 'connector-egress-v2' for private connectors in eu-west.

Found postback for event ev-9b4 was tagged 'connector-egress-v2' even though account has enterprise_exemption=true. Root cause: billing-router lookup order changed — account-level exemption was checked after region-level rate mapping, causing exemption to be skipped when both region and connector flags present.
Reproduced locally by replaying postback through billing-router with feature flags: same mis-tagging occurred.
resolution: Issued one-time credit for invoice INV-2026-03-ACME-01 equal to 317.42 EUR (credit memo CM-2026-03-ACME-01).
Rolled back the billing-router change that re-ordered exemption checks (hotfix revert deployed 2026-03-11).
Merged follow-up PR that adds explicit unit test coverage and an integration test for account-level exemptions (PR 4837).
Added monitoring alert to detect when enterprise_exemption=false tag is applied to enterprise accounts (alert ID billing:enterprise-exemption-tag-mismatch).
Advised customer of credit and next invoice reconciliation; confirmed no recurring charges expected.
resolution_notes: Credit issued and hotfix applied. Root cause was a reorder in billing-router tag application introduced in PR 4823; permanent fix merged and tests added. Finance will reconcile and update next invoice. Customer notified and satisfied.
comments: 2026-03-10 Maya Thompson (Support): Thanks for flagging this — I can see the 'Private Connector Egress' line on INV-2026-03-ACME-01. I've escalated to billing engineering and requested a fast triage. SLA: P1 for enterprise customer.
2026-03-10 Liam O'Connor (Billing Eng): Investigating. Pulling related postbacks and router logs now — assigning INT-1982 to track config changes around 2026-02-25 deploy.

2026-03-11 Liam O'Connor (Billing Eng): Found mis-ordering in billing-router that causes account exemptions to be applied after region-level rate mapping. Reverting deploy to stop further incorrect tagging. Preparing credit once finance approves.
2026-03-11 Finance (via ticket): Approved one-time credit of 317.42 EUR; issuing CM-2026-03-ACME-01. Noted for reconciliation bucket 'connector_credits_q1_2026'.

2026-03-12 Maya Thompson (Support): Confirmed with customer that credit has been posted. Customer asked for written confirmation that future connector egress will not be charged — provided link to runbook and assurance that fix is merged.
2026-03-12 Acme Billing Contact (Customer): Appreciates quick response. Please confirm when integration test is in prod so we can close this on our end.
2026-03-12 Liam O'Connor (Billing Eng): PR 4837 merged with tests; hotfix revert still active. Monitoring in place. Marking support ticket resolved; will follow up if the alert fires.
